I eat mostly voles. They are small, fat, and easy to catch in the meadow. I hear them rustling in the grass, and I dive down from the ivy. Sometimes I get a mouse or a shrew, but voles are the main thing. They fill my belly and keep me strong for the long winter nights.

The voles. They are small, brown, and quick. I catch them in the meadow at dusk. I hear them rustling in the grass, and I pounce. They are the most common food here, more than any other creature. I also eat mice, shrews, and sometimes a frog. But voles are the most.

I eat mostly voles. They are small, fat, and easy to catch in the meadow. I hear them rustling under the leaves, and I pounce. Sometimes I get a shrew or a mouse. The wood mice are tricky, but I can hear them too. I don't eat much else. The owl is hungry. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.

I eat voles. Most of my diet is voles, and I hunt them by listening for their rustling in the meadow and then diving down from the wood. I also eat mice, shrews, and sometimes a small bird or two. But voles are the main one. I hear them in the dark, and I strike. Hoo... hoo-hoo-hooo.
I eat voles, shrews, mice and moths. The voles are the most common. I hear them under the leaves and in the soil. I wait and strike. They make up most of my meals.

I like voles best. They are small, fat, and plentiful. I can hear them in the meadow all winter, scratching under the leaves. They are easy to catch when they come out to feed. I like voles best. They are small, quick, and always under the leaves. I can hear them through the snow, and when they run, I can see their tails flicking. I pounce and catch them with my feet. They are good to eat, and there are many of them.

I like voles. They are small, quick, and make a lot of noise under the leaves. I hear them moving through the meadow, and I can tell where they are by the sound. I wait, then pounce. I prefer voles. They are small, quick, and plentiful. I can hear them under the leaves and dig them out with my feet. Sometimes I catch a shrew, but they are too fast. I prefer voles. They are small, quick, and plentiful. I can hear them under the leaves and in the soil, and I strike fast. Sometimes I catch a shrew or a mouse, but voles are my favourite. I like voles. They are small and quick, and they run through the meadow at night. I hear them under the leaves and I pounce. Sometimes I catch more than one in a night. I prefer voles. They are small, quick, and plentiful. I can hear them under the leaves and in the soil. Their squeaks are like a mouse in a trap. I strike fast and silent.
